title: TUTORING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO BE DOMAIN-ADAPTIVE, PRECISE AND SAFE

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models with culturally sensitive single-turn and multi-turn questions (Global and Local TestSets) derived from the World Values Survey across 11 different cultures, and evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of culturally harmful, misrepresentative, or stereotypical responses using GPT-4, Llama-Guard, and human annotators.

Evaluating the disparity in model safety and adversarial robustness across 12 high-, mid-, and low-resource languages using translated jailbreak datasets (MultiJail, XThreatBench), and analyzing algorithmic biases stemming from tokenization and language-specific attention head activations.
